_source: Google Sheet 'Materials Cloud Archive File Formats' (link utili.pdf)

tolerated..pdf: Accepted. Check it is not reproducing text from an unpublished paper (copyright).

case_by_case..pkl: Not recommended (arbitrary code execution, python-specific). Accept only if converting is not worth the effort.
case_by_case..eps: Unclear if open format; widespread, accept.

blocked..rar: Not an open format. Ask for .zip / .7z / .tar.gz.
blocked..mat: Matlab, proprietary and undocumented. Ask for compressed CSV or HDF5.
blocked..m: Matlab. Ask for an open alternative.
blocked..opj: Origin project file. Ask for CSV.
blocked..opju: Origin project file. Ask for CSV.
blocked..pyc: Compiled bytecode, not a data format, unnecessary.
